```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r"^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

It checks for one `@`, a valid domain, and a dot-plus-letters ending like `.com`. Good enough for form checks, but not a full RFC 5322 match — for that, real delivery is the only true test.
